signal_detail: VUTEQ inaugurated Plant II in Apaseo el Grande, Guanajuato, an automotive plastic injection molding plant with a USD 100 million investment and 135 new jobs.

Kikkoman Foods opened its third U.S. production facility in Jefferson, Wisconsin, a 240,000 sq ft soy sauce and seasonings plant with an investment of about USD 560 million over 10 years and 80+ jobs.
Döhler opened a new 12-hectare plant for natural flavors and colors in Soyaniquilpan, Estado de México, with an investment above MXN 1,200 million.
Toyota Motor North America announced a USD 3.6 billion expansion of its San Antonio, Texas plant, adding a second assembly line for the Tacoma and 2,000 jobs.
Opella announced MXN 2,300 million to expand and modernize its plant in Ocoyoacac, Estado de México, including a new Enterogermina production line.
